description: Minimal IPC for the main window only: core events plus the app's narrow host commands (capabilities booleans, busy report, ready ping, login start, sign-out). The https://* remote context is confined by navigation.rs to the approved first-party origin plus the configured SSO identity-provider origin; every host command additionally rejects callers not on the first-party origin (host.rs require_first_party), and the init script exposes nothing on other origins.
